question_audit.title: Eligibility and consent
question_audit.help: Continue only if you meet the eligibility conditions, have read the information above, understand that participation is voluntary, and agree to the use of your answers for BUS334 coursework. If you do not agree, close the survey without submitting.
options: Yes, I meet the conditions and agree to take part.
No, I do not meet the conditions or do not agree.
question_audit.expectedHelp: Continue only if you meet the eligibility conditions, have read the information above, understand that participation is voluntary, and agree to the use of your answers for BUS334 coursework. If you do not agree, close the survey without submitting.

question_audit.title: 1. What is your gender?
2. Which nationality group best describes you?
question_audit.help: This refers to nationality, not ethnicity. Choose the group that best fits; use the multiple-nationalities option if needed.
question_audit.expectedHelp: This refers to nationality, not ethnicity. Choose the group that best fits; use the multiple-nationalities option if needed.

question_audit.title: 3. In a typical teaching week, how many days do you attend campus?
4. In a typical teaching week, how many times do you buy food or drinks on campus days?
question_audit.help: Include purchases on campus, nearby, and through delivery apps during those campus days.
question_audit.expectedHelp: Include purchases on campus, nearby, and through delivery apps during those campus days.

question_audit.title: 5. Where do you most often get food or drinks on a campus day?
question_audit.help: Choose one main source. If two are equally common, choose the one you used most recently.
options: I do not eat or drink during campus days
question_audit.expectedHelp: Choose one main source. If two are equally common, choose the one you used most recently.

question_audit.title: 6. About how much do you spend on food and drinks on a typical campus day?
question_audit.help: Include purchases on campus, nearby and by delivery. Round to the nearest whole dirham.
question_audit.expectedHelp: Include purchases on campus, nearby and by delivery. Round to the nearest whole dirham.

question_audit.title: 7. How satisfied are you with the food and drink options currently available on or near campus?
options: I have not used them / cannot say

question_audit.title: 8. Which products, if any, are difficult to find on or near campus when you need them?
question_audit.help: A sentence or two is enough. Write "None" or "Not sure" if appropriate.
question_audit.expectedHelp: A sentence or two is enough. Write "None" or "Not sure" if appropriate.

question_audit.title: 9. If the store stocked the products you wanted at prices similar to nearby shops, how likely would you be to buy from it?
10. How often would you expect to buy from this store during teaching weeks?
11. About how much would you expect to spend on each visit to this store?
question_audit.help: Round to the nearest whole dirham. These are your expectations, not a commitment to spend.
question_audit.expectedHelp: Round to the nearest whole dirham. These are your expectations, not a commitment to spend.

question_audit.title: 12. Which products would you be most likely to buy from the store?
question_audit.help: Select up to three. If you choose "I would not buy anything" or "Not sure", choose it alone.
options: Basic groceries to take home, such as rice, pasta or eggs
question_audit.expectedHelp: Select up to three. If you choose "I would not buy anything" or "Not sure", choose it alone.

question_audit.title: 13. Would you use the campus store to buy groceries to take home?
14. Which factor is most important to you when choosing a grocery store?
15. When would you be most likely to shop at the campus store?
16. Suppose a 500 ml bottle of plain water costs AED 5 at a nearby shop. What is the most you would pay for an identical bottle at the campus store?
question_audit.help: This is a hypothetical example, not a claim about current market prices. Round your maximum to the nearest whole dirham.
options: I would not buy this product
question_audit.expectedHelp: This is a hypothetical example, not a claim about current market prices. Round your maximum to the nearest whole dirham.

question_audit.title: 17. What, if anything, would put you off shopping at this campus store?
question_audit.help: A sentence or two is enough. Write "Nothing" or "Not sure" if appropriate.
question_audit.expectedHelp: A sentence or two is enough. Write "Nothing" or "Not sure" if appropriate.

question_audit.title: 18. Which offer, if any, would most encourage you to buy from the store?
options: Food and drink bundle at a lower price
Reduced prices on products close to their best-before date

question_audit.title: 19. How would you most prefer to hear about the store and its offers?
question_audit.help: Choose one main channel. This question does not sign you up for any messages.
question_audit.expectedHelp: Choose one main channel. This question does not sign you up for any messages.

question_audit.title: 20. What could the store do, if anything, to make you keep using it during the term?
question_audit.help: A sentence or two is enough. Write "Nothing" or "Not sure" if appropriate.
question_audit.expectedHelp: A sentence or two is enough. Write "Nothing" or "Not sure" if appropriate.
